name: UDR-5G-Max
title: Dream Router 5G Max
summary: Desktop all-in-one: WiFi 7 router with full 5G NR modem, 10G SFP+, 4x 2.5GbE, microSD NVR.

special: built-in 5G NR Sub-6 modem (3.4 Gbps NSA peak)
requires: carrier SIM/eSIM data plan for cellular WAN

gotchas: Only one PoE port and it is 802.3af (15.4W) — cannot power a PoE+ AP like the U7 Pro (21W); plan a PoE switch or injector.
microSD NVR handles just (1) 4K / (2) 2K / (5) HD cameras — use a UNVR or UDM-SE-class gateway for real Protect deployments.
Integrated radio is 2x2 per band, 160 m² coverage — add APs for anything bigger than an apartment/small office.
Capped at ~30 UniFi devices and 2.3 Gbps IPS; for multi-gig wired sites a UDM-SE/Pro Max class gateway scales further.
5G needs your own carrier plan; for wired-primary sites wanting only failover, a U5G backup antenna + any gateway is cheaper.
best_for: small office wanting 5G + WiFi 7 in one box
